title: Move Notion pages with AI to the parent you choose
h1: put a notion page under its new parent
description: Ask a bot to move an existing Notion page under another page or into a database data source. Confirm both references before changing its location.
keywords: ai move notion page to database
answer: you can move an existing notion page under a different page, or place it in a database using that database's link. a bot needs the page to move and the exact destination. this is a location change without an automatic send approval, so make confirmation part of the instruction before you give it permission to move anything.
og_line: move the page, with a clear destination.
what:
move page changes where an existing page sits. it needs the source page link and a destination, rather than a title that could point to several places. search notion pages and databases can help identify the source and a page destination from their names.

the destination type matters. moving into a database works differently from moving under a page; the bot checks which you mean before it moves anything.
uses: file a completed event brief beneath the correct annual archive page
move a standalone project note into its agreed database destination
place a misplaced onboarding page under the team handbook without rewriting it

routine.message: on the first friday of each month at 13:45, look under the events page i linked for event briefs whose event date has passed. list them here with where each would go under the archive page i linked, and ask me before moving any. never move a database, rewrite a brief or pick a destination by title alone.
routine.when: first friday of the month at 13:45
routine.needs: notion connected, with read and write access to the source and destination
routine.output:
event briefs proposed for archive

rookhaven winter fair brief: event date has passed
from: events
to: events archive / winter fairs
waiting for your ok before moving anything.

steps: open **Connected apps**, allow this bot to use notion and set **read and write** for the move.
give both source and destination references; ask the bot to distinguish a page from a database target.
ask the bot to name both pages and wait for your ok before it moves anything.
check the moved page in notion and **Pause** the routine after the filing job is complete.
watch: if a move into a database fails, tell the bot it's a database, not a page.
a familiar title is not enough to identify which page should move when several copies exist.
read-only access blocks moves, while enabling writes does not make the sending setting supervise them.

faq.q: can it move a page into a database?
faq.a: yes. paste the database link and the bot finds the right place for it.

faq.q: does this also rewrite the page for its new home?
faq.a: the action moves an existing page. any content revision is a different task and should have its own explicit instruction.
